name: final-memory

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: memwatch report after the whole boot: guard still running, minimum MemAvailable 69066 MiB >= the 8192 MiB floor
bench all: guard minimum over the floor, guard running
bench profile: guard minimum over the floor after one and four concurrent cold 262,144-token prompts and a decode burst
profile: one cold prompt of the window (262,144 tokens), the code found
profile: 4 concurrent cold prompts of the window, every code found

commands: ./inkling2mini.sh memwatch begin; ./inkling2mini.sh bench all   (gate memory: the guard's minimum against the engine floor, memcheck.py)
./inkling2mini.sh bench profile   (capacity line; GPU MiB and MemAvailable at ready; one cold 262,144-token prompt; 4 concurrent ones; a decode burst; node-side sampler)
./inkling2mini.sh memwatch report   (after every gate of the boot: the guard's minimum since it armed, loading included)
notes: Boot g, shipping defaults (drafter, prefix cache 16 entries, vision tower), GPU capped at 2,200 MHz, the memory guard armed on the server pid for the whole boot. guard_min_mib is the guard's lowest MemAvailable sample since it armed (loading included) over everything the boot ran: the gates of bench all, the sweeps, the quality, tool and loop probes and the profile bracket; the engine's floor is 8 GiB (8,192 MiB). sampled_* are the node-side 5 s sampler over the profile only.
